contexts.text: Evil Spirits in the World of Spirits sometimes consociate in cohorts... but they are dispersed by other cohorts of Spirits... The cohorts of Spirits who thus disperse them are called the east wind. AC 2128:end. SE 2122.
There are cohorts of Spirits who wander about, and whom Spirits are terribly afraid of... AC 2128.
The Spirits of Mercury go by regiments and divisions...
There were many Spirits (of the fourth Earth) in sight, and they were in companies.
There were six troops or cohorts... CL 3. CL 4. CL 5. CL 7.
There was a company of Spirits reasoning about imputation and predestination...
When I had said this, the company of Spirits retired from around me...
Unless armies were distinguished into divisions; these into regiments; and these into troops...
There are regiments of (these babbling Spirits); more than can be conceived.
